facts.text: The building dates from 1922 and was formerly the Federal Reserve Bank of Boston before being converted into a hotel in 1981.
facts.excerpt: Built in 1922, The Langham was formerly The Federal Reserve Bank of Boston before being converted into a hotel in 1981.

facts.text: The building is a protected historic landmark under the Boston Landmarks Commission.
facts.excerpt: As a historic landmark, the building is protected by the Boston Landmarks Commission, and looks almost exactly like it did back in its banking days.

facts.text: The hotel's art collection pays homage to the building's banking history and local heritage.
facts.excerpt: The Langham, Boston features a stunning art collection that pays homage to the building's banking history and local heritage.

facts.text: The former bank left behind two early-20th-century N.C. Wyeth murals.
facts.excerpt: the bank left behind two towering early-20th-century N.C. Wyeth murals

facts.text: Grana, the hotel's Italian restaurant, sits in a former bank hall with French chandeliers, original stone floors and a three-dimensional Lady Liberty head.
facts.excerpt: a grandiose atrium adorned with French chandeliers, original stone floors, and a three-dimensional Lady Liberty head watching over the dining room.

facts.text: The Fed is a street-level bar serving pub fare, raw-bar seafood and cocktails.
facts.excerpt: The Fed, a street-level bar that serves elevated pub fare, raw-bar seafood, and inventive cocktails

facts.text: Guests of Club Rooms and Suites have complimentary access to The Langham Club.
facts.excerpt: Guests of Club Rooms and Suites enjoy complimentary access to The Langham Club, a serene retreat with personalized service.

facts.text: The Langham Club offers full breakfast with an omelet station, afternoon snacks, and evening cocktails and a light dinner.
facts.excerpt: full breakfast with omelet station, afternoon treats and snacks, and evening cocktails and light dinner from our talented culinary team.

facts.text: The hotel has a bilevel 24-hour fitness center, a heated indoor pool, a hot tub and saunas.
facts.excerpt: the bilevel 24-hour fitness center with Peloton bikes, Echelon mirrors, a heated indoor pool, hot tub, and saunas
While there's no spa, the bilevel 24-hour fitness center

facts.text: Every subway line intersects near the hotel, giving easy access to outer neighborhoods.
facts.excerpt: every T (subway) line intersects here for ultra-easy access to virtually every outer neighborhood.

facts.text: The minibars are stocked with Massachusetts-sourced goods.
facts.excerpt: not-so-mini bars stocked with Massachusetts-sourced goodies

facts.text: The Club Bi-Level Family Suite spans two floors with a living area, pull-out sofa and half bath downstairs and the master bedroom upstairs.
facts.excerpt: Experience a two-story suite for the whole family, featuring large living area with pull-out sofa and half bath on first floor, master bedroom on the second floor and access to The Langham Club.

facts.text: The Chairman Suite has a walk-in closet, a fireplace and a piano.
facts.excerpt: Experience the height of luxury with elegant amenities including a full walk-in closet, fireplace, and piano.

facts.text: The hotel sources most of its ingredients from New England purveyors and businesses.
facts.excerpt: We source most of our ingredients from New England purveyors and businesses.

facts.text: The hotel is ADA-compliant with wheelchair-accessible rooms and elevators.
facts.excerpt: ADA-compliant, with wheelchair-accessible rooms and elevators.
